environment.memory_note: Linux: /proc/self/status VmHWM after conversion, since exec, including imports. Other POSIX: getrusage ru_maxrss (may include inherited high-water mark). Resource metrics unavailable on Windows.
environment.dependency_installation_note: Dependencies were loaded from inspected upstream source because direct pip network access was unavailable. pikepdf was not installed, so the historical fork selected the internal img2pdf engine; normal dependency-resolved installations can select another engine.

methodology: Fixed-seed textured images. Fresh process per trial. Original batch sleep=0; fork sequential; default quality policies differ. Conversion includes redesign verification/fsync. Fidelity is checked outside timing for every page. Temporary logical byte samples every 5 ms are lower bounds. CBR not measured: no representative comic RAR fixture.

post_measurement_review.change: After measurement, OutputTransaction cleanup gained try/finally so unlink is attempted even if buffered close raises. Successful conversion logic is unchanged. The new failure-injection regression, all 81 tests, and final-smoke.json validate the final source.
